title: Centralize other income canonicalization
description: Add a shared helper for normalizing other income types and resolving canonical income categories, including the rule that Exgratia must be included in the Bonus taxable/reporting bucket unless displayed as a separate non-overlapping column.
convergence: All callers can ask one helper whether a row belongs to THR, BONUS, KONTAN, CUSTOM, or a dynamic category, and Exgratia is never dropped from Pajak.
